name: arbeitnow-jobs-mcp
description: Arbeitnow (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyless feed whose only documented parameter is page, so query and location are not sent — filter the returned postings client-side; the page size is fixed by the platform (do not pass limit). description is HTML; remote, tags[], job_types[] and created_at (type not documented on the page) are in raw. Terms: the API is provided 'as is' and 'We may revoke the permission to use API at any time'; no published rate limit.
